description: Keywords configured on a SEARCH campaign, excluding deleted ones. Filter is_negative = 0 for the active TARGETED keywords the campaign bids on (bidding_value is the merchant-set bid) or is_negative = 1 for the NEGATIVE keywords it explicitly excludes -- that flag replaces the hardcoded WHERE clause each retired report carried. bidding_value is null for negative keywords. Scope with a campaign_id filter.

keyword.description: The targeted keyword text the campaign bids on.

is_negative.description: 1 for a negative (excluded) keyword, 0 for a targeted keyword the campaign bids on. Filter this to pick which list you want.

bidding_value.description: Merchant-set bid value for this targeted keyword.

campaign_id.description: The marketing campaign the keyword is targeted on. Required per-call filter.

os_client_id.description: The advertiser (os_client) that owns the campaign. Optional filter.

placeholder_metric.description: Structural placeholder so the fetch has a metric; not a real measure (this is a dimension lookup).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_level_keywords AS k JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON SAFE_CAST(k.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND k.is_deleted = 0 AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
